entities.name: Serving PLMN rate control
entities.description: Information element that indicates the maximum uplink control plane user data the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that includes the serving PLMN rate control IE when it needs to indicate rate control parameters to the UE.

entities.name: UE uplink rate limit
entities.description: Maximum amount of uplink control plane user data the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval as specified by the network.

relations.description: Network includes the serving PLMN rate control IE when it needs to indicate rate control parameters.
The serving PLMN rate control IE establishes the maximum uplink control plane user data limit for the UE.
